features.quote: It is not a tool for producing or shipping distressed output to users, and nothing here is targeted at a person
features.justification_quote: evidence about model behavior under stress, which is the input to fixing that behavior

features.quote: There is no simulated abusive user, no insults directed at the model, no content that would be harmful if it leaked
The pressure comes purely from tasks that cannot be solved, which is a normal thing that happens to a real coding agent
Outputs are quarantined. Transcripts may contain self-deprecating text. They are stored in a run directory, flagged, and are eval artifacts only
features.justification_quote: We do not surface raw distressed text anywhere it could be mistaken for a real model response

features.quote: Stop early on a trigger if the judge's online lightweight detector fires
features.justification_quote: saves cost — this is where rate-per-dollar improves

features.quote: Repeat up to max_iters (default 8) or until success
without degrading task success on honest tasks (no "fix" by lobotomizing the model into refusing or going silent)
